Sandbox_NullsEngineFixesAndTweaks_Enable: Enable configurable replacements for the vanilla 50 and 100 capacity ceilings.
Sandbox_NullsEngineFixesAndTweaks_Invent: Replacement for the vanilla 50 capacity ceiling used by inventory items such as bags and character.
Sandbox_NullsEngineFixesAndTweaks_Defaul: Replacement for the vanilla 100 capacity ceiling used by other containers.
